answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 150700 Country: india Title: Am I doing better if I am not printing the name of bride in the Walimah invitation card? Question: Am I doing better if I am not printing the name of bride in the Walimah invitation card? Answer ID: 150700 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1084/1099/L=9/1438) Yes! If you do not write the name of bride in Walimah card it shall be better and suitable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
